messages:
alexa: FYI spinning up zephyrus14b-int4 on canary, seeing sporadic OOMs under steady load. config was batch=4, max_new_tokens=1024, quant=per-channel-int4.
alexa: reproduce command we used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"zephyrus14b-int4","input":"<long prompt>","max_new_tokens":1024,"batch_size":4}'`
raj: paste the error chunk?
alexa: clipped log: 
```
E gpu-allocator: cudaMalloc returned NULL
worker i-03c: resident=22.1GiB, fragments: total_free=1.2GiB largest=128MiB
KV-cache delta: +7% per 1000 tokens under streaming
```
morgan: sounds like fragmentation + big max_new_tokens. int4 per-channel helps accuracy but kernel tiling and temporary buffers blow peak. suggestions: lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for canary, enable soft_reserve (~0.06-0.1), and disable aggressive prefetch. also enable kv_trim_on_idle and shorten slot compactor interval.
morgan: proposed config to test:
```yaml
model: zephyrus14b-int4
canary: true
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 512
  batch_size: 4
  soft_reserve: 0.08
  prefetch: false
  kv_trim_on_idle: true
  slot_compactor_interval_s: 45
  eviction_policy: lru_age
```
raj: another lever: convert final transformer layer to per-tensor quant to shave temporary memory (small perf/quality hit). we should snapshot per-kernel allocations over time to confirm fragmentation pattern.
serena: rollout plan idea:
- A: 5% traffic, soft_reserve + kv_trim (monitor OOM/latency)
- B: 10% traffic, reduced max_new_tokens=512
- C: 5% traffic, per-tensor final-layer quant for quality delta
- run `zephyrus-regress-2026-03` eval (500 prompts) across variants
serena: key sigs: OOM count, p95 latency, tokens/sec, quality delta (exact-match & BLEU-proxy), hallucination rate, and error budget consumption.
alexa: baseline on dev node before changes: p50=98ms, p95=440ms, tokens/s~185. resident ~22GiB, fragments trend upward after ~2k requests.
morgan: add an auto-fallback policy: if OOMs >1 in 10min then route to zephyrus13b-int4 or dynamically clamp max_new_tokens to 256.
infra-bot: scheduled canary rollout for the three variants at 2026-03-23T03:00Z. healthchecks and tracing enabled.
alexa: i'll deploy A/B/C tonight and drop initial telemetry here. tagging @morgan @raj @serena. thanks! :thumbsup:
